comments.body:
Quest name: Famous Books of China
Quest location: San Francisco Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Appraisal, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Journey to the West discovery (from "Tracing Back the Footsteps of Xuanzang" quest) + Water Margin discovery (from "Book Loved by the Ming People" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Treasure Hunter's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
